haikus.haiku:
Pumpkin lights glow bright
Crickets sing in dusk haze soft
Moon whispers sweet treats
Happy #Halloween from @ClamBakeSanta

Apple gleams in sun
Caramel drips, sweet breeze, soft
Taste of joy, bright glow
Happy #NationalCaramelAppleDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright sunrise soft greets
Gentle breeze carries laughter
Poet smiles, heart sings
#HappyBirthdayJohnKeats from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning light spills bright
Soft breeze hums across room warm
Joy blooms in each cup
#HappyBirthdayJanVermeer from @ClamBakeSanta
